settings.background_geolocation_denied: Background location needs the "Allow all the time" permission. Allow it in your device settings, then turn this on again.
settings.login_info_description: Sign in again, for example after changing your password or to switch to another account.
settings.no_units_available_help: No units are assigned to you. Ask your department administrator to add you to a unit's station group.
settings.sounds.modern_only: Alerts use the modern Resgrid sound set. Each type of alert has its own tone.
settings.units_load_failed: Couldn't load units. Check your connection and try again.
storage_sync.action_failed: That did not work. Try again.
storage_sync.clear_all_description: Removes everything this app stored on this device, including map packs and changes not sent yet, and signs you out. Device preferences such as language and theme are kept.
storage_sync.clear_all_message: Everything this app stored on this device is removed and you are signed out.
storage_sync.clear_all_message_unsent: {{count}} changes have not been sent yet and will be lost. Everything this app stored on this device is removed and you are signed out.
storage_sync.clear_cached_description: Removes downloaded data and map packs; they download again when needed. You stay signed in and unsent changes are kept.
storage_sync.clear_cached_message: Downloaded data and map packs are removed and download again when needed. You stay signed in and unsent changes are kept.
storage_sync.diagnostics_description: A summary for Resgrid support: counts and sizes only, never your department's records.
storage_sync.discard_message: This change will never reach the server. This cannot be undone.
storage_sync.held: {{count}} changes from another account or server are kept on this device.
storage_sync.no_pending: No changes waiting to be sent.
storage_sync.over_budget: Using {{used}} of {{budget}}. The oldest cached data is removed first; unsent changes are never removed.
storage_sync.report_failed: Storage information could not be read. Pull down to try again.
storage_sync.sync_failed: Sync failed. Check your connection and try again.
storage_sync.sync_partial: Some data could not be synced. It will be tried again automatically.
storage_sync.title: Storage & sync
storage_sync.unavailable: Storage information is not available yet. Try again in a moment.
